name: Santa Fé do Araguaia (Brazil)
description: Light blue field with a diagonal band of yellow and green rising from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms: a yellow shield with a bull's head under a dove, between branches, with the motto O FUTURO É AQUI and the date 1º DE JANEIRO DE 1993.
history: Santa Fé do Araguaia is a municipality in the state of Tocantins, Brazil.
